name: GPEx Universal Upgrade Propagation Doctrine
purpose: Ensure that improvements, fixes, naming conventions, safety rules, and BIC-level patterns established in one GPEx subsystem can propagate responsibly across all related systems.
core_law: One truth improves. All dependent systems learn. Nothing buyer-facing changes until audited.
why_this_exists: Avoid isolated fixes that improve one lane while leaving related lanes behind.
Preserve BIC-level conventions across the enterprise.
Prevent public buyer flow from drifting away from internal doctrine.
Allow platform learning without unsafe auto-publication.
Turn every proven fix into reusable enterprise knowledge.

doctrine.description: Rules, ethics, naming conventions, safety principles, and operating laws.
examples: Revenue is allowed. Harm is not.
Remember to care better. Never remember to manipulate.

data_shape.description: Schemas, record templates, required fields, and registry formats.

audit.description: Repeatable proof scripts that prevent regression.

buyer_flow.description: User-facing routes, wording, audio, purchase, and delivery logic.

sensory_interpretation.description: How PIX/K-KUT/KKr records become emotionally safe, sensory-aware, human-use objects.

platform_process.description: How 4PE process improvements become reusable GPEx operating practice.

propagation_gate: Check whether the improvement is doctrine, data shape, audit, buyer flow, sensory interpretation, or platform process.
Create or update internal doctrine first.
Add an audit before public use.
do_not_propagate_automatically: anything that increases pressure, manipulation, or emotional harm
healthy_upgrade_law: Healthy is purposeful. A GPEx upgrade is valid only when it increases clarity, care, safety, usefulness, or BIC-level reliability.
biconvention_law: BIC-level conventions must become reusable enterprise doctrine, not one-off patches.
human_care_law: Technical propagation must never outrun human care.
buyer_safety_law: Buyer-facing surfaces receive only approved, audited, route-safe, human-meaningful improvements.
future_target: Create a GPEx propagation registry that records every major fix, the systems it affects, audit status, public status, and next propagation target.
